$comment: H1, the event batch: POST /v1/ingest, a factory's mailbox events, from its mailbox pusher to its own
record and from that record's forwarder to Hestia. Spec: specs factory-push-spec.md §2, §3, §6 and
record-spec.md §4. Map: agent-slack docs/contracts/factory-contract-map.md H1, H8, F1. Sample rule and
index: contracts/README.md. This file is the record side (hestia's card ingest-contract); the mailbox
How it is used: `events` is one valid envelope per event type the record knows, in emission (id)
order; posted together as {"factory": `factory`, "events": [<each envelope>]} by a key of
`factory`, every one is accepted, typed (never stored as unknown) and lands in each table its
`projects_to` names (an empty list: stored in events, nothing else). `response` is the 202 for that
batch, then for the same batch again. `cell_pause_after` is the cell's pause state after the batch.
`quarantined` are rows the reader parks: posted as [events[0].envelope, <row>], the batch is a 202 and
the row is answered in `rejected` with a reason holding `reason_contains`. `statuses` is one case per
refusal: `body` is posted as is; `events` instead is that many copies of events[0].envelope, each
with its id suffixed -<n>; `body_bytes` instead is a well-formed batch of exactly that size (pad it
with an unknown top-level string field; the bytes are described, not inlined); `key` is whose key
sends it; `error_contains` is a substring of the {"error": ...} body.

writers.repo: record (the forwarder, events it already accepted)

settings.retry: decisions.md 2026-10-25 ruling 4: a sender honours Retry-After whenever a 429 or a 503 carries it, at most retry_after_cap_seconds; without it, every 5xx (503 included) goes on the doubling backoff, backoff_start_seconds doubling to backoff_cap_seconds; a 429 without it waits retry_after_absent_seconds
settings.max_events: RECORD_INGEST_MAX on the reader; DISCUSS_PUSH_BATCH and RECORD_FORWARD_BATCH must not exceed it
settings.rate_per_second: RECORD_INGEST_RATE, a token bucket per factory, burst RECORD_INGEST_BURST
settings.max_body_bytes: fixed in the record (model.MaxBodyBytes), not configurable

envelope_rules: factory is optional; when present it equals the batch's factory
at is unix milliseconds, greater than 0
a null or absent payload is {}
an unknown type is stored and not projected; an unknown payload field is tolerated; a field of the wrong type is quarantined

quarantined.name: a payload field of the wrong type

statuses.name: malformed
statuses.error_contains: not a batch: malformed JSON body

statuses.name: no factory
statuses.error_contains: not a batch: factory is required

statuses.name: another factory's key
statuses.error_contains: this key cannot push for factory lodestar

statuses.name: over the bucket
statuses.after: burst batches in the same instant (the bucket is empty)
statuses.error_contains: too many batches from factory lodestar
statuses.sender: wait Retry-After seconds (an HTTP date also), at most 300, whenever a 429 or a 503 carries it; a 429 without it waits 5; a 5xx without it, 503 included, goes on the doubling backoff (1 s doubling to 60 s)
